tools.name: about_siteprint
tools.description: Siteprint's two products (the web app in any browser and the Safari extension for Mac), what each does, and their pricing.

tools.name: list_example_designs
tools.description: Real Siteprint scans of four public sites, each with the original page a coding agent built from it. Returns ids for get_example_design.

tools.name: get_example_design
tools.description: The DESIGN.md Siteprint exported from one example scan: exact colours, type, spacing, corners and layout as a design direction for new UI.

tools.name: get_setup
tools.description: How to connect the person's own Siteprint designs to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or another client: the web app's remote server with a key, or the Safari extension's local server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_setup" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "How to connect Siteprint's local MCP server, which serves the person's own scans, to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or another client." → after: "How to connect the person's own Siteprint designs to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or another client: the web app's remote server with a key, or the Safari extension's local server."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
